incident_clusters.description: Feature 'Introduces the Content Comparison Modal' led to two follow-up hotfixes: PR 26083 ('Comparison <- fix reactivity issue') and PR 26078 ('Comparison <- small fix, add more tests'), indicating issues with reactivity and user display in the comparison modal.

Feature 'Add field-level searchable option' (PR 25970) likely caused regression leading to PR 26049 ('Fix "Is one of" search failing with number values'). The issue (25886) also points to 'is one of' problem.

Feature '2FA Setup for OAuth Users' (PR 25695) led to PR 26059 ('Fix accounts with minimum access permissions unable to add 2fa'), indicating an access permission issue with 2FA setup for OAuth users. Issue 25948 is linked.

Feature 'Enhance CSV export functionality' (PR 26136) was preceded by PR 26005 ('fix(csv-export): add UTF-8 BOM to all CSV exports for Excel compatibility'). While 26005 was closed earlier, 26136 then also addressed CSV export with BOM, suggesting an iterative or possibly problematic area.

Feature 'Fix layout display dependant on item count request' (PR 26045) was followed by PR 26154 ('Fix tabular view loading items after delay'), suggesting performance or loading issues in list views after recent layout changes.
